测试南向出口和返向入口。守闸机挡路时，可以分头操作两个停机开关，省下正面拆机的时: Test the south exit and the return entrance. If the sentinel blocks your way, split up and work its two shutdown switches.

备份要经过两次环境结算。启动前先看终端会不会挨打，备份完成后把硬盘带走。: The backup takes two round ends. Check the threats to the terminal before you start it, then carry the drive out.
先隔离故障节点，再让日志安全下线。中继会召来巡检机，留人牵制增援能给取证争取时间: Isolate the faulty node, then take the log offline safely. The relay calls in scouts. Holding them off buys time to recover the warning record.
把药品带走，或恢复冷库供电，都能保住这批药。时间够的话两边都做，社区会记下这份额: Carry out the medicine or restore the cold room's power. Either will save the stock. If you can do both, the community will remember the extra help.
三栋楼同时来电。先选一处能赶到的求援点，再决定还有余力回应哪一处。: Three buildings are calling at once. Pick a call you can reach, then see which others you still have time to answer.
先清出运输通道，再接居民登船。有余力时再带上物资箱。: Clear the transport lane, then help the residents aboard. Collect the supplies if the crew has time to spare.
修泵能保住排水能力，路远、工量也大。封闭支路更近，但街区状态上限会降至2。第一次: Repairing the pump preserves drainage but takes more travel and work. Sealing the branch is closer and caps the district's condition at 2. Your first action on either branch commits you.
先解除干扰，再发出通告。广播需要维持两轮，可以留人保护终端，或先让附近机器停机。: Clear the interference and start the broadcast. It needs two rounds. Leave someone to protect the terminal or shut down nearby machines first.
病人和临时集合点都需要人手。可以让一人负责搬运，另两人去加固。: Both the patient and the assembly point need help. One person can take the patient while the other two reinforce the shelter.
先护住一所避难所。时间充足时，再支援另一所或转移两所之间的伤员。: Protect one shelter first. With time to spare, help the second shelter or bring out the injured person between them.
先恢复撤离主线。旧闸档案和备用路线标记分在别处，分人过去会拖慢主路施工。: Restore the main evacuation route. The old gate records and the backup route marker are elsewhere. Sending people after them leaves fewer hands on the main job.
先完成终端交接。可以同时核验报警记录，或删去无关者的姓名，为日后公开作准备。: Complete the terminal handover. You can also verify the warning record or remove bystanders' names before anyone makes it public.
两组居民都在等船。先把人接走，再衡量是否绕去搬重建材料。今晚还要选定终战路线。: Two groups of residents are waiting for a boat. Get them aboard before deciding whether to detour for rebuilding supplies. Tonight the crew chooses its final route.
昨晚选定的路线决定这次任务。核对必做目标，给最后撤出的人留好通路。: Last night's route determines today's assignment. Check the required objectives and keep an exit clear for the last person out.
联络船修好，社区就能恢复往来。船票登记册可以一起带回。: Repair the ferry to reconnect the community. You can bring back the ticket ledger too.
药箱和旧书都有人等。带回一箱就能交差，另一箱要看现场余力。: People are waiting for both the medicine and the books. Bring back one crate to finish the assignment, or both if you have time.
先断开电梯驱动，再接乘客出来。: Cut power to the lift drive, then bring the passenger out.
可以把种箱带走，也可以固定灌溉架，让这片菜园继续生长。: Carry the seed box to safety or secure the irrigation frame so the garden can keep growing here.
先隔离配电柜，再取走绝缘布。留出一条能把布送到出口的路。: Isolate the electrical cabinet before collecting the insulation cloth. Leave a clear path to carry it out.
先找出住户的位置，再把人接出来。有余力时顺路送回保温盒。: Find the resident, then bring them to safety. Return the insulated meal box if you have time.
先把失联的记录员救出来。档案可以另行备份。: Rescue the missing clerk first. Making a separate copy of the files is optional.
行李装着私人物品，工具箱关系到今后谋生。选一箱带走。: The luggage holds personal belongings. The tools could help someone earn a living later. Choose a crate to take out.
把临时教室加固好。时间允许的话，再帮孩子们带出教材。: Reinforce the makeshift classroom. If time allows, bring the children's teaching materials out too.
备用引航灯需要修复。可绕开守闸机，也可先用两个开关把它停下。: Repair the backup navigation light. Go around the sentinel or shut it down with both switches.
先接好诊所的后备供电。冷藏药柜还需要人持续照料，决定留下前先看机器的预告。: Connect the clinic's backup power. The medicine fridge needs someone to keep watch. Check the machines' forecasts before committing a crew member.
把社区名册带上船，家庭照片可以顺路抢救。这是最后一次可选出勤，之后还有一晚营地。: Get the community register aboard and save the family photos if you can. This is the last optional assignment. One night at camp remains.
改派东侧接应（2物资、替换普通出口为(8,8)、不获得后勤物资；须已达成苏棠与江: Move pickup east to (8,8) for 2 supplies. This replaces the regular exit and the supply gain. Su Tang must have a cooperation agreement with Jiang Shuo or Mo Yao, with one in the field and the other on logistics.
你们当时没有定下个人计划，这里还没有可以核对的履约记录。: You didn't agree on a personal plan. There's no promise on record to verify.
